title: 25 animals found dumped in Bulacan claimed by owners; families seek justice
summary: All 25 animals whose remains were discovered dumped in a vacant lot in San Jose del Monte City, Bulacan, have been accounted for and claimed by their pet owners as of Saturday evening.
